title: Diocles of the Medes
summary: Raleigh names Diocles of the Medes in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Diocles, who raigned 53 yeeres in Eusebius his list of the Kings of Media after Arbaces. He is not Diocles, cited by Iosephus on Nabuchodonosors siege of Tyre. The one-word title would fold onto diocles, so the title is four words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
